result.summary:
Implemented exactly the approved design (lib/letflow/design/iss0703-oidc-verifier-exception-handling.md) against lib/letflow/oidc/token_verifier/oidcc.ex: appended a `rescue`/`catch` clause pair to the existing `def verify_bearer_token/2` (function-clause sugar, `with` body unchanged), producing {:error, {:verifier_crashed, %{kind: :error | :exit | :throw, message: String.t()}}} on any non-local exit from Oidcc.ClientContext.from_configuration_worker/4 or Oidcc.Token.validate_jwt/3, logging via Logger.warning/1 (module+function name, kind=, message=, never raw_token) before returning. Added @type crash_reason and the explicit @spec from design §5. Corrected the @doc above verify_bearer_token/2 to the exact text in design §6 (moduledoc itself left unchanged, per design). No change to auth_pipeline.ex -- confirmed by re-reading auth_pipeline.ex:140-254: the existing {:error, {:verify, _reason}} -> 401 clause in handle_auth_error/2 already matches the new nested reason shape unchanged, matching the design's own §3/§8 finding; no gap found, none reported.

`mix compile` output: 'Compiling 1 file (.ex)' -- clean, zero warnings.
`mix format --check-formatted lib/letflow/oidc/token_verifier/oidcc.ex` -- exit 0 (already formatted).
`mix test test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_test.exs`: 'Result: 10 passed' -- all pass, unmodified.
`mix test test/letflow/oidc/` (claim_mapping_test.exs, claim_mapping_property_test.exs, jit_provisioning_config_test.exs): 'Result: 33 passed (2 properties, 31 tests)'.
`mix test test/letflow/integration/keycloak_auth_pipeline_test.exs --include keycloak`: setup_all raised 'Keycloak not ready at http://localhost:8093/...' despite `docker compose up -d keycloak` showing the container healthy and `curl http://localhost:8093/realms/bpm-default/.well-known/openid-configuration` returning HTTP 200 directly. Root-caused independently (not a regression from this change): a standalone `elixir -e` script calling `:httpc.request/4` against `http://localhost:8093/...` returned `{:error, :timeout}`, while the identical request against `http://127.0.0.1:8093/...` returned `{:ok, {{...},200,...}}` -- this sandbox's `:httpc`/`:inets` fails to connect over IPv6 (`::1`, which curl also tried first but then correctly fell back off) for 'localhost' and the test's 1000ms connect_timeout is too short to fall back, all before setup_all's probe even reaches AuthPipeline or the changed adapter code. This is a pre-existing environment/networking limitation of this sandbox, unrelated to the oidcc.ex change (the probe fails before any changed code path runs), and outside this handoff's scope to fix (test-infra changes are not authorized here). Flagging as a MINOR environmental note, not a code defect.
